units.source_text: 我不论是睡觉还是醒来，都希望有为子死去，但愿我的耻辱的见证人销声匿迹。

en.t: Whether asleep or awake, I wished that Uiko would die, and that the witness to my shame would vanish without a trace.

units.source_text: 只要没有见证人，或许耻辱便会从人世间根绝。

en.t: If only there were no witness, perhaps shame itself would be rooted out from the world of men.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，只要没有他人，也就不会产生耻辱嘛。

en.t: Even so, if there were no other people, shame could never arise.

units.source_text: 我仿佛看见有为子的面影，在黎明前的黑暗中像水一般晶亮，

en.t: I seemed to see Uiko's face, clear and shining like water in the darkness before dawn,

units.source_text: 她直勾勾地盯着我的嘴，

en.t: as she stared fixedly at my mouth,

units.source_text: 她的眼睛的后面存在他人的世界——也就是说，

en.t: and behind her eyes there existed the world of other people - that is to say,

units.source_text: 仿佛看见绝不让我们独自存在而主动地成为我们的同谋和见证人的他人的世界。

en.t: I seemed to see a world of others who would never let us exist alone, but who would willingly become our accomplices and our witnesses.
Other people must die and disappear.

units.source_text: 为了我能够真正面向太阳，世界必须死灭……

en.t: For me to truly face the sun, the world itself must die and disappear...
